bio: What a lovely place! This attractive building may be a bit out of the way, but it's worth the journey, especially in summer if you can secure a spot on the wonderful garden terrace! It is also pleasant to dine inside, in the elegant restaurant. Whichever space you plump for, you will be treated to courteous service – Bernadette Lisibach, the extremely friendly owner, also makes frequent appearances at the tables. She really puts her heart and soul into running this place, using select ingredients in her fuss-free, tasty and expressive cooking, which leans towards the classical. Diners choose between two set menus. There is a good wine list and a nice selection of cheeses to round off the whole experience....
